product.name: Scope to Quote
product.wish: 让自由职业者填写项目范围和费用，得到清楚、可打印的客户报价单，并验证是否有人愿意为此付费。
product.audience: English-speaking freelance designers preparing a fixed-price project quote
product.coreOutcome: One saved, itemized project quote with scope, revisions and payment schedule
product.implementation: Deterministic templates and calculations; no AI or external data claims

journey: Inspect a labeled sample and the price
Fill in bounded scope and fee fields as a guest
See a free summary, then sign in while preserving the draft
Pay once for the saved quote version using Stripe Checkout
Open the complete quote after verified payment and print it in the browser
Return to the saved quote and optionally leave feedback

offer.deliverable: Access to one complete saved quote version and browser printing
offer.grantRule: Verified paid order for this immutable record version, without refund or active dispute
offer.fulfillment: Short local database transaction; no external work in webhook
offer.refundOperation: Stripe Dashboard, with verified event sync and reconciliation

experiment.hypothesis: Freelance designers will pay for a usable client quote without writing the document themselves
experiment.qualifiedSampleDefinition: Unique non-test visitors from the selected relevant channel; uncertain identity or source remains unknown
experiment.supportRule: Meet the sample and paid-customer thresholds; all counted paid orders delivered, with no unresolved failures and no refunds during the observation window; collect feedback before deciding the next experiment
experiment.insufficientEvidenceRule: Below the minimum sample or material measurement gaps means inconclusive
exclusions: friends buying only to support the creator
experiment.decisionScope: Evidence for this audience, offer and time window only; not proof of PMF or retention

acceptance.completionRule: All gates require environment-specific evidence before production_verified and public live checkout; market conclusions remain separate
